svg.title: Brimansh Frontier Trader - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Traders and Gunboats (2024), printed 186-187, PDF 187-188. Combined aligned decks preserve rounded central hull, aft stem, broad swept crescent wings and small curved forward fins. Lower plan supplies full wing envelope; upper deck fits within central body using shared stern/grid alignment. Illustration corroborates rear crescent and forward fins. Bow right in source, rotated up; curved external contours interpreted smoothly, room borders omitted.
